items.title: Add capacity-aware single-flight delivery admission
items.summary: Specify a reusable admission policy that links proposals, change requests, improvements, and work items; rejects duplicates; prevents conflicting site overlap; and defers work when active capacity is full.
items.requested_action: Approve a product specification for implementation through the normal engineer queue after containment clears. Reuse existing queue, proposal, improvement, and work-item records; do not add telemetry or change schedules.

items.title: Make measurement handoff a first-class delivery state
items.summary: Standardize the transition from deployed work to measurement, including baseline, owner, due date, evidence window, outcome state, and explicit close-or-follow-up disposition.
items.requested_action: Approve a product specification that consolidates existing measurement workflows and prevents overlapping work until the current improvement reaches a measured, regressed, inconclusive, or justified-close state. Do not request new telemetry or claim causal lift.
